narrative.overview: A single warm sheet of paper, set in Song, corrected in red. The page presents its owner as a text still being edited: a printed statement, a handwritten margin that admits the honest version, and a stamp that refuses to call the draft finished. It is not a portfolio grid and not a résumé; it is a one-person publication whose form is the argument.
keyCharacteristics: Warm proof paper, near-black ink, correction red and pencil blue as the only chroma.
A printed Song voice, a handwritten Kai voice, and a mono slug line; never more.
One continuous sheet with a binding rail, folios, crop marks, and a fore-edge tab index.
The 校样/清样 toggle: the same page with the annotations turned off.
Flat, square, rule-led; no cards, no shadows, no gradients.
Motion in two-frame steps; one stamp lands, one line grows.

rules.name: The Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Red is correction ink, never a filled surface. It belongs to marks, rules, stamps, the reading line, and the contact link. Blue is the second pass: paused work, the clean stamp.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Song sets the printed statement; Kai is only for the margin, inserts, and signature. Mono is only for slugs and measurements. Body copy is never set in Kai.

rules.name: The Binding Rule
rules.body: The left binding rail carries folios and proof metadata; the fore-edge carries the tab index. Content never crosses the binding line.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: No box shadows. Depth comes from layers of paper and ink: the fixed reading line, the annotation leaf, hairline rules, and the stamp.

rules.name: The Two-Frame Rule
rules.body: State changes step in two frames. The stamp lands once; the reading line grows linearly. No scroll reveals, no decorative fades.

dos: Do keep the sheet asymmetric: binding margin left, fore-edge tabs right.
Do keep functional text at 11px or larger; body at 17–19px with 1.88–1.95 line height.
Do keep the prose measure around 30–34 Chinese characters (about 65–75ch).
Do preserve the marked/clean toggle and the no-JavaScript marked fallback.
Do use one stamp per view; its rarity is the mark.
donts: Don't wrap sections in cards, rounded rectangles, or soft-shadow panels.
Don't use gradients, glass, blur, or colored background fills.
Don't set body copy in Kai or use mono as a costume for prose.
Don't add a centered avatar hero, a kicker above headings, or a row of equal project cards.
Don't add scroll-reveal animations or more than one accent at a time.
